description.value:
You inscribe a small fūinjutsu pattern on a scroll, parchment, or your own forearm. The seal can store one unattended object of up to Light Bulk, returning it instantly when you 'release' the seal with a free action (within reach).

The seal lasts indefinitely. You can have at most (your spellcasting modifier) Storage Seals active at one time. Drawing items takes a free action; storing takes 1 action.

Heightened (3rd) Each seal can store up to 1 Bulk; you may have an additional seal active.

Heightened (5th) Each seal can store up to 5 Bulk; items in storage are protected from environmental damage.
